title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term helps prevent overfitting by penalizing large coefficients.

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing the regularization parameter lambda in ridge regression affects the estimated parameters. Consider how the penalty term in the loss function changes with lambda.

hintAnswer: The second term increases leading to smaller values of theta.
